about: One entry per exported row (products.json): the run and time that observed it, the code revision of that run, the stored page with its SHA-256 and store checks, the store-assortment decision, each field's source and observation time, and the UPC outcome. A carried-forward row points to its own earlier run. A replay's row is 'replayed': observed by the replay's source run (observed_by_run, at observed_at, on its stored page) and read again by the replay (read_again_by_run) with the code in 'code'; never a fresh observation. A row carried from a replay names the same two runs.
